content.clinical_guideline: The document contains guidelines and studies related to vascular interventions, spanning topics like stenting, surgical bypass, and management of conditions like carotid artery stenosis, fibromuscular dysplasia, and arterial dissections. It emphasizes outcomes and various methods such as stents, surgical grafting, and angioplasty.
